title: Verify that a visitor reaches the Economic Consultancy page from the main menu and sees every published section
description: All four sections are published and active.

steps.action: Open the Qatar Chamber website in English
steps.expected: Home page loads with the main menu visible

steps.action: Click 'Our Services' in the main menu
steps.expected: 'Our Services' dropdown expands

steps.action: Click 'Economic Consultancy' in the dropdown
steps.expected: The Economic Consultancy page loads

steps.action: Observe the page from hero to footer
steps.expected: Breadcrumb 'Home > Services' renders over the maroon hero, which shows the eyebrow 'Economic Information Service', the title 'Economic Consultancy & Advisory' and its description beside the banner image; the quick facts read Market Intelligence / Official Chamber Reports, Turnaround Time / 5 Working Days, Service Fee / Free for Members and Sectoral Coverage / All National Sectors; the index lists 01 to 04 and all four sections render in order

title: Verify that clicking a section-index entry scrolls to that section and marks it active
description: The section index is sticky across four sections.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the sticky index visible

steps.action: Click '03 Scope & Exclusions' in the sticky section index
steps.expected: The viewport scrolls to Section 03 and its heading is in view

steps.action: Observe the viewport and the index
steps.expected: The '03 Scope & Exclusions' entry is marked active and the index stays sticky in the viewport

steps.action: Scroll back up and observe the index
steps.expected: The active marker follows the section currently in view rather than staying on Section 03

title: Verify that selecting a second section-index entry moves the active marker off the first
description: Repeat pass on the index control.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with all four index entries

steps.action: Click '03 Scope & Exclusions' in the index
steps.expected: Viewport moves to Section 03 and that entry is active

steps.action: Click '01 Overview' in the index
steps.expected: Viewport moves to Section 01 Overview

steps.action: Inspect all four index entries
steps.expected: Exactly one entry is marked active ('01 Overview') and Section 03 has returned to its default style

title: Verify that clicking an FAQ question expands its answer without a page reload

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Scroll to Section 04 Frequently asked questions
steps.expected: All active FAQ questions render as collapsed accordion headers with their answers hidden

steps.action: Record the browser navigation state, then click the first question
steps.expected: The first question expands

steps.action: Observe the answer and the navigation state
steps.expected: Its answer becomes visible with no page reload and no change to the browser URL

title: Verify that clicking an expanded FAQ question again collapses its answer
description: Reverse pass on the accordion control, starting from the first question expanded.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English and expand the first FAQ question
steps.expected: The first question is expanded and its answer is visible

steps.action: Click the same question again
steps.expected: The first question collapses and its answer is hidden again

steps.action: Click a different question
steps.expected: The second question expands

steps.action: Inspect both questions
steps.expected: Exactly the questions the visitor expanded are open; no answer opened or closed on its own

title: Verify that the breadcrumb links navigate to their targets
description: Verifies the two breadcrumb segments. Figma frame 2802:94813 carries the placeholder value 'Hcvxcxvcome' on the Breadcrumb component — see Open Risk R-6.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads with the hero rendered

steps.action: Inspect the breadcrumb in the hero
steps.expected: Breadcrumb shows a home icon, 'Home', a chevron-right separator, then 'Services' — and no placeholder text such as 'Hcvxcxvcome'

steps.action: Click the 'Home' breadcrumb link
steps.expected: Browser navigates to the Qatar Chamber home page

steps.action: Navigate back and click the 'Services' breadcrumb link
steps.expected: Browser navigates to the Services landing page

title: Verify that the language toggle switches the whole page between English and Arabic
description: The PBI requires all content to display in the selected language with correct LTR / RTL layout.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads left-to-right with English content

steps.action: Click the AR language toggle in the header
steps.expected: The page reloads in Arabic

steps.action: Inspect the hero, quick facts, section index and all four sections
steps.expected: Every label, section badge, section title, info card, highlight item, area card, scope item and FAQ question renders in Arabic, right-to-left, with no English text left in a translated field

steps.action: Click the EN toggle to switch back
steps.expected: The page returns to English left-to-right with the same content and the same scroll target

title: Verify that an active repeatable item renders with its full content in the configured position
description: Asserts ST-6 at element level for the second quick-facts tile.

steps.action: Log in to Liferay CMS as a Site Content Editor and open the Economic Consultancy page record and confirm the second quick-facts tile is Active with Display Order 2
steps.expected: The tile is Active with Display Order 2

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Scroll to the quick-facts strip
steps.expected: The strip renders its active tiles in order

steps.action: Inspect the second tile
steps.expected: The second tile shows its icon, the label 'Turnaround Time' and the value '5 Working Days', matching the values stored in the CMS

steps.action: Inspect an info card, the highlighted list, both scope lists and the FAQ accordion
steps.expected: Cards, the highlighted list, the accordion and the two scope blocks adopt their dark surfaces, and the green and red scope colours still meet a readable contrast

title: Verify that the Economic Consultancy page renders correctly at tablet viewport width

steps.action: Inspect the info cards, area cards, scope lists and the accordion
steps.expected: The info cards and area cards reflow to fewer columns, both scope lists stay distinguishable, and the accordion remains operable

title: Verify that the FAQ content on the published page is about economic consultancy and not another service
description: Several service pages in this sprint carry another service's copy in their designs — see Open Risk R-7. This case guards against the same slip reaching Economic Consultancy.

steps.action: Open the public Economic Consultancy page in English
steps.expected: Page loads

steps.action: Scroll to Section 04 Frequently asked questions
steps.expected: Section 04 renders its published questions

steps.action: Expand every FAQ item
steps.expected: Every answer expands

steps.action: Read each question and answer in full
steps.expected: Every question and answer concerns the economic consultancy service — economic information, business insights, who the service is for and where reports are found — and none refers to another Qatar Chamber service

title: Verify that a failure to load the Economic Consultancy page shows the standard site error page
description: Covers the unhappy delivery path so a broken page does not surface a raw server error to the visitor.

steps.action: Request the Economic Consultancy URL with the content service unavailable
steps.expected: The request completes

steps.action: Observe the response
steps.expected: The visitor sees the site's standard error page with the site header and footer, not a raw stack trace, a Liferay diagnostic screen or a blank page

steps.action: Request an Economic Consultancy sub-path that does not exist
steps.expected: The request completes

steps.action: Observe that response
steps.expected: The visitor sees the site's standard not-found page in the current language
